name: Kuurne - Brussel - Kuurne

intermediate.name: 1st passage of the finish line
intermediate.title: Sprint | 1st passage of the finish line (181.5 km)

story: Kuurne–Brussels–Kuurne unfolded at a fierce pace, with seven riders forming the decisive early breakaway. Tim Wellens crashed out, suffering a fractured collarbone. Several sprinters, including Jonathan Milan, Biniam Girmay, Arnaud De Lie and Paul Magnier, were dropped on the Mont Saint-Laurent. After late splits in the first group proved insignificant, a reduced bunch sprinted in Kuurne, where Matthew Brennan beat Luca Mozzato and Matteo Trentin.
